instruction: A candid family photograph in a medium shot captures a playful moment in an outdoor park with a grassy field and blurred background. The man in the white zip-up hoodie (R1) stands in the center, carrying the toddler in denim overalls (R3) on his shoulders while looking up and laughing. On the right, the woman in the black leather jacket (R2) stands in profile, looking up joyfully at the child. Together, the man (R1) and the woman (R2) hold the toddler's (R3) hands high in the air, forming a playful arch. The scene is bathed in soft, diffused daylight, featuring a muted, natural color palette and a shallow depth of field.
